_what: mira's bottleneck ablation: a learned linear bottleneck against progressively simpler maps, feature extractor and decoder held fixed. The learned-vs-random-frozen gap is what kmira's A/B calibration was built to reproduce.
_warning: Published numbers from a different setup (full video codec, fully trained, 8 GPUs). Only the GAP between two of mira's own rows is used as a calibration target -- never an absolute value.

calibration_target._what: The effect kmira's arm B was configured to reproduce: freezing the bottleneck at a random projection.
